node.title: L1 FPC5: rate-half M=4,t=3 guarded split-slice payment
node.statement: At the official rate-half row, fix one M=4,t=3 FPC5 source, touched triple, defect, and the normalized cross-ratio determined by that triple. For N=4ell+b-2, d=2ell-a, b>=7, 1<=a<=floor((b-3)/4), and J<=0, the cell is exactly the guarded LS6 atom of monic divisors D|L_C with deg D=2ell-a, deg rem_(L_2L_3)(D Etilde)<=ell-a, and gcd(D,rem(D Etilde))=1. First-layout atom collapse proves that fewer than 4n fixed atoms plus four anchors cover the global class. Every nonempty atom injects into an unpunctured full-domain split flat with j=2ell-a, r=ell-2a+1, 2r<j, flat-wide gcd one, and exponentially sub-unit ambient mean; it also has deg(Etilde)>=a. Aligned common-pencil sources are empty. The remaining conclusion is a uniform admissible primitive payment plus owner-safe treatment of misaligned quotient and dihedral strata, not a dimension estimate.
node.attack_surface: prove primitive max-to-mean split-flatness in the exact sub-balance 2r<j descriptor, plus owner-safe misaligned even-defect quotient and dihedral classification
node.falsifier: a family of fixed guarded LS6 atoms whose mass exceeds every uniform polynomial and every legitimate quotient/profile column
